name: Another World: Lost In Heart
summary:
Another World: Lost in Heart tells the story of a young swordswoman named Judy. It begins with her experiencing yet another nightmare, one tied to the fact that her brother has gone away on business and hasn’t contacted her for a long time. Judy has no choice but to uncover the reason behind her dreams — and to find out whether her brother is truly safe.

This is an RPG where the choices you make will shape how the story unfolds through its acts. Every decision matters — but can fate, or even the will of the Gods, truly be changed?
